name: GameAssist
description:
**GameAssist is a modular D&D 5E automation suite for Roll20. It brings combat, spell effects, NPC management, and campaign records together without forcing every campaign to use every feature.**

## At a Glance

- **15 configurable modules:** Enable only the tools your campaign needs.
- **No external Mods required:** Token and condition tools are integrated into GameAssist.
- **Native Roll20 workflows:** Roll initiative and run encounters in Roll20's native Turn Tracker.
- **Guided at the table:** Coordinate Bless and concentration, manage NPCs, and reach direct commands and deeper controls when you need them.

> **AlmanacAssist is in Alpha Testing.** Its calendar, weather, travel, and rest tools are optional and start disabled. Try them in a campaign copy, use disposable characters for rest tests, and [report a bug or request a feature](https://github.com/Mord-Eagle/GameAssist/issues). This Alpha designation applies to AlmanacAssist; **the rest of GameAssist v2.0.0 is in Beta Testing.**

---

## Requirements

- **Character sheets:** Sheet-based effects, healing, guided attacks, concentration saves, and rests target the official **D&D 5E (2014/Classic)** sheet. Support for official 2024 characters is currently limited and varies by feature and the data Roll20 exposes; this is not yet full-suite 2024 sheet support. Broader 2024 character-sheet support is planned.
- **NPC setup:** Link NPC tokens to their character, with the sheet's NPC setting enabled. Use `!ga-health bars` to choose the shared NPC HP bar: **1, 2, or 3**. Automatic NPC workflows use qualifying Objects-layer tokens; HP rolling also needs the character's `npc_hpformula`.
- **CritAssist tables:** If you use fumble-table rolls, create and populate `CF-Melee`, `CF-Ranged`, `CF-Thrown`, `CF-Spell`, `CF-Natural`, `Confirm-Crit-Martial`, and `Confirm-Crit-Magic`. GameAssist does not currently supply your campaign's table results.

---

## Quick Start

Commands beginning with `!` are entered in Roll20 chat.

> **Start here:** `!GA-GM` opens the GM home screen; `!ga-help` opens module guides; `!ga-nav` finds controls and settings.

**Command shortcuts:** GM and DM commands are equivalent and interchangeable. Command words ignore capitalization and accept space/hyphen forms: `!ga gm`, `!GA-GM`, and `!ga-dm` open the same home screen.

1. Add **GameAssist** from the game's **Mod (API) Scripts** library. Keep only one active copy.
2. Let the sandbox restart, then run `!ga-status` to check the installation.
3. Open `!ga-config ui` to review settings and enable the modules you want.
4. Choose your table timezone with `!ga-timezone`. If using NPC automation, check the HP bar through `!ga-health bars`.

---

## Included Modules

### Combat and Conditions

- **InitiativeAssist:** Roll for one character, selected characters, or groups of NPCs in Roll20's native Turn Tracker. Combine advantage or disadvantage with an adjustment and bonus dice. Reroll living NPCs and PCs without rerolling custom counters.
- **CombatAssist:** Run encounters in concert with the native tracker. Advance or revisit turns, follow round counters, recover supported tracker changes, and use optional timers, reminders, and current-turn pings. Player turn whispers offer an End My Turn button.
- **CritAssist:** Detect supported natural-1 attacks, offer the attacker a fumble menu, and roll from your campaign's tables. The GM can also open the player picker manually or roll martial and magical confirmation tables. If you use CritAssist for fumble-table rolls, create and populate `CF-Melee`, `CF-Ranged`, `CF-Thrown`, `CF-Spell`, `CF-Natural`, `Confirm-Crit-Martial`, and `Confirm-Crit-Magic`. GameAssist does not currently supply your campaign's table results.
- **ConcentrationAssist:** Roll supported Constitution saves with normal, advantage, or disadvantage choices; manage the concentration marker; and see who is concentrating. Optional private HP-loss prompts offer a check without automatically deciding its outcome. Settings include a built-in/custom marker picker.
- **ConditionAssist:** Look up, apply, remove, and announce conditions with marker artwork where available. Choose 2014 or 2024 SRD wording, edit campaign definitions, and review a page's active conditions. Descriptions can be public or whispered; custom conditions support quick-reference commands too.

### Characters, Effects, and NPCs

- **EffectAssist:** Coordinate sources, recipients, concentration, and supported 2014-sheet modifiers. **Bless, Guidance, Warding Bond, and Haste** include supported sheet automation; **Holy Weapon and Pass Without a Trace** are clearly labeled tracking-only. Player casting and GM controls share the same ownership checks. Ending an effect removes its own unchanged additions while preserving externally edited data. EffectAssist does not yet have full-suite 2024 sheet support. Broader 2024 character-sheet support is planned.
- **HealAssist:** Automatically roll and apply supported healing spells, potions, and manual formulas, with normal rolled healing or optional maximum healing.
- **AttackAssist:** Choose a controlled 2014-sheet character, an attack, and a visible target, then show the familiar sheet roll. **AttackAssist does not yet apply damage, resolve hits against AC, or spend resources.** AttackAssist does not yet have full-suite 2024 sheet support. Broader 2024 character-sheet support is planned.
- **NPCAssist:** Mark defeated NPCs, record revivals, and organize history into **Campaign > Chapter > Section > Session** handouts. Custom Arc rosters follow story threads. Audit HP/marker mismatches and review a separate repair before applying it. Optional Bloodied alerts and page-local NPC numbering help the GM manage a busy map.
- **HPAssist:** Roll NPC hit points for selected tokens or qualifying NPCs on the current player page. Optional automatic rolling initializes newly added NPCs.
- **TokenAssist:** Use a guided action library or commands to manage token names, bars, auras, layers, controllers, movement, vision, lighting, markers, and reports.

### Campaign and Control

- **AlmanacAssist - Alpha Testing:** Manage fictional time, custom calendars, moons, climate, seasonal weather, environments, and deliberate 2014-sheet rests. Choose Climate and Biome, add optional local details, then save and recall named places. Six systems have independent controls.
- **WelcomeAssist:** Welcome your table with a standard greeting, a varied built-in selection, or custom campaign messages. Announce when you are ready or enable automatic startup greetings.
- **ConfigUI:** Enable modules, find settings, and review the campaign's configuration from one GM-only interface. Shared controls include the NPC HP bar, table timezone, and optional private PC health alerts.
- **DebugTools:** Optional developer-level diagnostics for damage, markers, and saving throws. It starts disabled; when enabled, it previews changes unless the GM explicitly includes `--apply`. **Recommended for power users only.**

---

## Example at the Table

A cleric casts Bless on three allies. EffectAssist coordinates their markers and supported sheet modifiers while ConcentrationAssist tracks the caster. When concentration ends, the Bless effect is removed from the appropriate characters.

During combat, InitiativeAssist handles initiative rolls and CombatAssist offers turn controls and optional reminders. When you reduce an NPC to 0 HP, NPCAssist can mark the defeat and record it in the active reporting scopes. At the end of the session, review the history and write the reports to handouts.

## Main Commands

### Home, Settings, and Help

- `!GA-GM` or `!GA-DM` - Open the Game Master home screen.
- `!ga-help` / `!ga-nav` - Find module guides or browse their menus and settings.
- `!ga-config ui` / `!ga-config modules` - Adjust configuration or review module status.
- `!ga-enable <Module>` / `!ga-disable <Module>` - Enable or disable a named module.
- `!ga-status` / `!ga-status --details` - Review health and troubleshooting details.
- `!ga-health bars` / `!ga-health alerts` - Configure NPC HP bars or private PC health alerts.
- `!ga-timezone` / `!ga-handouts` - Set table time or find managed handouts.
- `!ga-config list` - Export a configuration snapshot, not a full campaign backup.

### At the Table

- `!Init-Go` / `!Init-GM` - Announce initiative publicly or open the private GM controls.
- `!Init-RR` - Reroll eligible PCs and living NPCs already in the tracker.
- `!Combat` - Open encounter controls.
- `!critfail` - Open the manual fumble player picker.
- `!condition` / `!condition status` - Inspect selected tokens or open the GM condition roster.
- `!cond-<condition>` - Read a named condition.
- `!concentration` / `!concentration --status` - Open save controls or list concentrating tokens.
- `!effect` / `!bless` - Open the effect catalog or start Bless casting.
- `!Heal` / `!Heal-Max` - Open normal or maximum-healing actions.
- `!Attack` - Choose an attacker, attack, and target.

### NPCs and Campaign Tools

- `!NPC-GM` / `!npc-death-report` - Open NPC controls or review death history.
- `!npc-death-audit` / `!npc-death-repair` - Find mismatches or separately review marker corrections.
- `!npc-death-write` / `!npc-death-arc` - Write reports or manage a custom Arc roster.
- `!HP-Selected` / `!HP-All` - Roll HP for qualifying selected or current-page NPCs.
- `!token` / `!Token-Actions` - Open token controls or the larger action library.
- `!Welcome` - Configure and preview table greetings.
- `!aa-gm` / `!aa current` - Open Almanac session controls or edit the current place's climate and surroundings.

The in-game guides cover choices, permissions, and examples. The [README](https://github.com/Mord-Eagle/GameAssist#readme) contains the complete command and configuration reference.

---

## Working Alongside Other Mods

Overlapping behavior matters more than the mere presence of another Mod. Decide which tool owns each shared job:

- **HP and token bars:** Other scripts that modify NPC HP or use `bar1_value`, or the selected `bar2_value`/`bar3_value`, can trigger health and death tracking. Avoid two automatic NPC HP rollers or two tools applying the same healing. The OGL Companion's NPC HP features are one example.
- **Markers and sheet modifiers:** Two tools managing the same condition, concentration marker, or global modifier row can compete. Let one tool own each effect.
- **Turn order:** Other initiative rollers and combat managers may reroll, advance, reorder, or announce the same turns. Use one active turn-flow owner; leave optional GameAssist automation off when another tool handles it.
- **Shared commands:** TokenMod and StatusInfo overlap the integrated token/condition tools. Other Mods may also use short commands such as `!time`, `!weather`, or `!rest`. Use the documented namespaced forms and disable overlapping handlers where necessary.
- **Fumbles and greetings:** Duplicate natural-1 handlers or startup announcements can produce repeated menus and messages.

TokenAssist and ConditionAssist draw on work by **The Aaron** and **Robin Kuiper**; see [Attributions](https://github.com/Mord-Eagle/GameAssist/blob/main/ATTRIBUTIONS.md) for sources and license notices.

## Previous Versions and Upgrading

Use **2.0.0** for the current feature set. The legacy selection retains these milestones:

- **1.8.2:** The final pre-v2 baseline, including canonical module names, NPC Bloodied alerts, and progressive NPC naming.
- **1.7.0:** CombatAssist, native round-counter support, timers, and turn controls.
- **1.6.1:** InitiativeAssist and WelcomeAssist.
- **1.5.1:** Integrated token/condition tools and configurable table timezones.
- **0.1.4.7:** The standalone TokenMod-era release. Its marker workflows still require standalone TokenMod; optional StatusInfo remains separate.

Previously published **0.1.1.x** versions are retained too. Historical builds keep their original version numbers and command sets; the v2.0.0 feature list does not apply to them.

**Changing the installed script version does not roll back saved campaign data.** Test version changes in a campaign copy and follow the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/Mord-Eagle/GameAssist#15-upgrade-paths). A configuration snapshot is not a complete backup.

## Troubleshooting and Support

Start with `!ga-status`. Use `!ga-status --details` and `!ga-nav` to reach the affected module's settings, guide, or audit. If something fails, include the GameAssist version, sheet type, exact command, expected result, and any sandbox error in your report.

**Documentation:** [Read the full documentation](https://github.com/Mord-Eagle/GameAssist#readme)

**Support:** [Report a bug or request a feature](https://github.com/Mord-Eagle/GameAssist/issues)
conflicts: Other scripts that modify NPC HP or use bar1_value
Other scripts that automatically add or remove the same death, concentration, condition, or EffectAssist projection markers
Other scripts that create, edit, or remove global attack, saving-throw, or AC modifier rows on the D&D 5E by Roll20 2014 sheet
Other scripts that automatically process natural 1 attack rolls or open critical-fumble menus
Other scripts that reroll initiative, advance turns, count rounds, insert round counters, or rewrite Roll20's Turn Tracker
Other scripts that automatically post campaign-ready or startup greeting messages
Other scripts that respond to the same !time, !date, !cal, !weather, !rest, !astro, !clim, or !enviro commands
Other scripts that automatically restore the same 2014-sheet HP, Hit Dice, or spell-slot fields during rests
Other scripts that automatically apply healing or write the same character HP attributes
Other scripts or macros that guide or automatically submit the same repeating attack rolls or announce the same attacker and target
Other scripts that modify NPC HP or use bar2_value or bar3_value when GameAssist is configured to use those bars
